title: ESP32-S3 ChaCha20-Poly1305 stack A/B (#275, #278, #279, #280), CPU at 80 MHz
board: Seeed XIAO ESP32-S3 class board, ESP32-S3 rev v0.2, 8 MB flash, USB-Serial/JTAG; the board whose MAC ends 37:68

toolchain.rustc: rustc 1.97.0-nightly (8ea53bcd7 2026-07-08) (esp 1.97.0.0), xtensa-esp32s3-none-elf, opt-level 3, lto fat, codegen-units 1

harness: WS-BENCH firmware for the S3 (private copy of the student repo's firmware-s3, not published here): ChaCha20-Poly1305 seal/open and Ed25519 for rind and RustCrypto/dalek. A row is the firmware's median of `iters` timed samples (32, or 8 for Ed25519).
note: Control of an interleaved A/B on one ESP32-S3. Each run is one flash of the control image; the run's value is the median over that boot's complete rounds. Every flash of every image is in ab.json.

ctl.what: #275 then: 26-bit Poly1305 and word-XOR ChaCha20 on 32-bit targets

zero.what: #278 then (#275 merged in): the key wipe as one memset

chacha.what: #279 then (#278 merged in): ChaCha20 rotates as ssai/src on Xtensa

all.what: #280 then (#279 merged in): branchless Poly1305 block loop and 16-bit tag add

results_intro: Interleaved flashes of the fork's stacked ESP32-S3 ChaCha20-Poly1305 branches on one ESP32-S3. The tables below are the control image. [ab.md](ab.md) has every image against the control, [RUNS.md](RUNS.md) every control run, and [NOTES.md](NOTES.md) the method, the run counts and what each image is.
results_ab: [ab.md](ab.md) has every image against the control, flash by flash. Images flashed fewer than three times do not meet the three-run rule; [NOTES.md](NOTES.md) says which.
